options.content: **What the house uses, from its DNS.** The DNS observer summarises what the house resolves: services (registrable domains), who serves them (CDN) and on which networks (AS). It ranks them by **presence**, the hours of the last week each was seen. It changes no target: it shows what an automatic selection would work from. The top-services table needs `smoking-pi config set DNS_EXPORT_NAMES 1`, because service names are private and Grafana may be reachable from outside. See docs/dns-observer.md, "The DNS wizard".

panels.title: The house, as a whole (no names)
Services this week
panels.description: Distinct services (registrable domains) seen in the last 7 days, the Pi's own traffic left out.

targets.query: from(bucket: "smokeping") |> range(start: -25h) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "dns_wizard" and (r._field == "service_richness")) |> last()

panels.title: Effective services
panels.description: 1/HHI of the services' presence: how many equally-used services would give the same concentration. Far below the count = a few dominate.

targets.query: from(bucket: "smokeping") |> range(start: -25h) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "dns_wizard" and (r._field == "service_effective_hhi")) |> last()

panels.title: Networks (AS) this week
panels.description: Distinct origin networks behind those services.

targets.query: from(bucket: "smokeping") |> range(start: -25h) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "dns_wizard" and (r._field == "asn_richness")) |> last()

panels.title: Effective networks
panels.description: 1/HHI over networks. Much lower than effective services: many services share a few networks (Cloudflare, Amazon, Google).

targets.query: from(bucket: "smokeping") |> range(start: -25h) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "dns_wizard" and (r._field == "asn_effective_hhi")) |> last()

panels.title: Top 10 kept since yesterday
panels.description: Jaccard of today's top-10 services with yesterday's. 100% = no churn.

targets.query: from(bucket: "smokeping") |> range(start: -25h) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "dns_wizard" and (r._field == "top10_jaccard")) |> last()

panels.title: The Pi's own share (24 h)
panels.description: Queries from the Pi itself (image pulls, tunnel, alerts, SmokePing lookups) left out of everything here.

targets.query: from(bucket: "smokeping") |> range(start: -25h) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "dns_wizard" and (r._field == "own_share_24h")) |> last()

panels.title: CDNs behind the top 10
panels.description: How many distinct CDNs serve the 10 most present services.

targets.query: from(bucket: "smokeping") |> range(start: -25h) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "dns_wizard" and (r._field == "top10_distinct_cdn")) |> last()

panels.title: Networks behind the top 10
panels.description: How many distinct networks (AS) serve them. Measuring the top 10 covers only these paths.

targets.query: from(bucket: "smokeping") |> range(start: -25h) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "dns_wizard" and (r._field == "top10_distinct_asn")) |> last()

panels.title: Queries (last hour)
panels.description: Queries the house made in the last hour, without the Pi's own.

targets.query: from(bucket: "smokeping") |> range(start: -25h) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "dns_wizard" and (r._field == "queries_1h")) |> last()

panels.title: Hours of data
panels.description: Hours of the last week with any query: presence is out of this many.

targets.query: from(bucket: "smokeping") |> range(start: -25h) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "dns_wizard" and (r._field == "hours_with_data")) |> last()

panels.title: Effective number (1/HHI)
panels.description: How many equally-used units would give the same concentration, per aggregation level. The gap between services and networks is the diversity that grouping by network hides.

targets.query: from(bucket: "smokeping") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "dns_wizard" and (r._field == "service_effective_hhi" or r._field == "cdn_effective_hhi" or r._field == "asn_effective_hhi")) |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false) |> drop(columns: ["_start", "_stop", "_measurement"]) |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")

panels.title: Share covered by the top K (services, by presence)
panels.description: What fraction of the week's presence the top 5, 10 and 20 services cover: how much a target list of that size would miss.

targets.query: from(bucket: "smokeping") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "dns_wizard" and (r._field == "service_cov5" or r._field == "service_cov10" or r._field == "service_cov20")) |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false) |> drop(columns: ["_start", "_stop", "_measurement"]) |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")

panels.title: Top-10 churn
panels.description: Share of the top 10 kept from the day before (Jaccard). Low values mean an automatic selection would keep swapping targets.

targets.query: from(bucket: "smokeping") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "dns_wizard" and (r._field == "top10_jaccard")) |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false) |> drop(columns: ["_start", "_stop", "_measurement"]) |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")

panels.title: Queries
panels.description: Queries the house made in the hour before each snapshot, without the Pi's own.

targets.query: from(bucket: "smokeping") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "dns_wizard" and (r._field == "queries_1h")) |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false) |> drop(columns: ["_start", "_stop", "_measurement"]) |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")

panels.title: Top services by presence
panels.description: The latest snapshot only, so services that dropped out do not linger. Presence = hours of the last week seen. Host = the busiest stable name, the candidate endpoint to measure. Empty unless DNS_EXPORT_NAMES=1.

targets.query:
data = from(bucket: "smokeping")
  |> range(start: -1d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "dns_wizard_service")
latest = data
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "rank")
  |> group()
  |> keep(columns: ["_time"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 1)
  |> findRecord(fn: (key) => true, idx: 0)
// With DNS_EXPORT_NAMES off there is no snapshot: an empty table, not an error.
latestTime = if exists latest._time then latest._time else time(v: 0)
data
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._time == latestTime)
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time", "service", "cdn", "asn", "org"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> group()
  |> keep(columns: ["rank", "service", "presence_h", "queries_24h", "queries_1h", "host", "cdn", "asn", "org"])
  |> sort(columns: ["rank"])
